blocks.prompt: Measured full height, tip to the top of the collar, in
Measured bare hex above the collar, in
Weight on the scale, fight-ready, g
What was fixed, or what still has to change

criteria.text: The Blade is built and fight-ready

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The photo shows the whole Blade assembled: body, blades, hex and collar.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Assembled, but one part is missing or loose in the photo.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only some of the parts are together.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photo of a built Blade.

criteria.text: The Blade is measured and weighed

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Across, height, collar and bare hex measured with calipers, and a fight-ready weight off the scale.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of the five numbers is missing or cannot be read.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more numbers are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No numbers.

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Passed, or the fix is named
levels.descriptor: Passed inspection, or names exactly what was fixed or still has to change.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Did not pass and does not say what has to change.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No inspection result.

blocks.prompt: How far it got in the bracket
What a match showed about the design

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: How it finished, with wins, losses and how far it got, or why it did not fight.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: How it finished, but the record or how far it got is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing about how it finished.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names a part of the design and what a match showed about it, with the reason.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the part but not why it happened.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says something happened with no part of the design in it.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

blocks.prompt: Screenshot of your finished slide in the class deck
Your slide number in the class deck

criteria.text: Every box on the slide is filled

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Every box, photo in, tag gone
levels.descriptor: Name, theme, team, roles, the three numbers, the tournament line and one change are all filled, a photo fills the frame, and the TEMPLATE tag is deleted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One or two boxes still show the template text, or there is no photo.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Most boxes still show the template text.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot of a slide.

criteria.text: The numbers on the slide are the real ones

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Mass, height and across on the slide match Stage 1, and the tournament line matches Stage 2.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One number does not match.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more numbers do not match, or are still 000.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The numbers were never filled in.

criteria.text: One change next time, with a reason

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: One specific change to the design, and why.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A change with no reason, or too general to build.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The box is still the template text.
